=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ai_engine.sh:323-326 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The read-profile container mounts the original workdir instead of a credential-free snapshot, leaving credential-bearing files readable.
  WHY: `build_read_snapshot` is not invoked at runtime, so its filters do not apply; both reviewers rate this BLOCKER.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:188-192 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `READ_PROFILE_DENY` omits Grep denials for `.git-credentials`, `.netrc`, and `~/.claude/.credentials.json`, and omits Glob denial for `~/.config/gh/**`.
  WHY: Read-profile sessions enable Grep and Glob, allowing credential contents or configuration paths to be inspected despite the existing Read denials.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1257-1284 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `build_read_snapshot` does not handle tracked files deleted from the working tree when calling `lstat()`.
  WHY: A deleted tracked path raises `FileNotFoundError` and aborts snapshot creation; all three reviewers rate this MAJOR.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1311 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `build_read_snapshot` sets every copied file to mode `0644`, stripping executable bits.
  WHY: Tracked executables then appear as mode changes in Git status or diff, and may fail to run; severity varies from NIT to MAJOR, so the highest rating is used.
- tests/test_security_audit_workflow_contract.py:1211 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The test uses fragile `text.index` boundaries to extract a script section and mocks only one stderr file.
  WHY: Script restructuring can select the wrong section or raise `ValueError`, and the single-file mock does not exercise multiple stderr files.
- scripts/security_audit.sh:1298-1308 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The stderr-dump loop emits the tail of every `stderr-*.txt` file, potentially repeating credential-bearing provider errors.
  WHY: Multiple failed account attempts can place repeated secret-bearing tails in `err.txt`, which is a workflow artifact.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/claude_engine.py:190-192 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `READ_PROFILE_DENY` omits Grep denials for `**/.git-credentials`, `**/.netrc`, and `~/.claude/.credentials.json`, and Glob denial for `~/.config/gh/**`.
  WHY: Read-profile Claude sessions have Read, Grep, Glob, and Bash tools, so prompt-influenced text can direct Grep or Glob to inspect and disclose credential data or paths.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1311 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `build_read_snapshot` unconditionally sets target permissions to mode `0o644` for all copied regular files.
  WHY: Tracked executables appear as mode changes in Git status or diff, and attempting to run them can fail with Permission denied.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:1279-1284 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `build_read_snapshot` does not handle `FileNotFoundError` for tracked files or directories deleted from the working tree.
  WHY: `current.lstat()` or `path.lstat()` raises, aborting snapshot creation.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Run read-profile Claude calls in claude_run against an isolated, credential-free bounded source snapshot inside the container, falling back to codex/OpenCode if snapshot creation fails or limits are exceeded.
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh in _ai_engine_claude_run_isolated (lines 301-331)
  Evidence of absence: scripts/ai_engine.sh adds doc comments describing snapshot isolation at lines 43-44, but _ai_engine_claude_run_isolated never executes the read-snapshot subcommand or build_read_snapshot. Instead, line 323 directly bind-mounts the host workdir readonly (--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly"). The configuration limits CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_FILES and CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES documented in README.md and agents.md are never read or enforced during execution, and no credential-free snapshot directory is created or mounted.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Run the summariser in an isolated, credential-free source snapshot; keep the token pool and authenticated Git configuration outside its readable filesystem." (issue #6262 Recommendation; AD-2 picks "Both: isolation (B) as the main control, plus deny rules (A) as an extra layer.")
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh::_ai_engine_claude_run_isolated (around line 301, immediately before the workdir bind-mount at line 323) and a new caller of scripts/claude_engine.py::build_read_snapshot (defined at line 1209, with CLI at cmd_read_snapshot line 1340 and subparser at line 1469). The runtime must (a) generate a credential-free snapshot of ${workdir} into a tmp dir, (b) bind-mount the snapshot in place of ${workdir}, (c) honor CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_FILES / CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES, and (d) fall back to codex/OpenCode on snapshot failure rather than mounting the host workdir.
  Evidence of absence: The original PR DIFF (and LAST RUN DIFF) ship zero callers of build_read_snapshot / cmd_read_snapshot — `grep -n 'build_read_snapshot\|cmd_read_snapshot\|read-snapshot' scripts/ ai_engine.sh` returns only the definitions in scripts/claude_engine.py and the four test references in tests/test_claude_engine.py. scripts/ai_engine.sh::claude_run (line 448) and _ai_engine_claude_run_isolated (line 301) still bind-mount the unmodified host workdir at line 323 (`mounts=(--mount "type=bind,src=${workdir},dst=${workdir},readonly")`). The PR's own README addition (lines 1962-1963) documents CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_FILES / CLAUDE_READ_SNAPSHOT_MAX_BYTES, agents.md (lines 243-247) claims "uses a bounded source snapshot inside a network-isolated Docker container", the changelog fragment changelog.d/6262-read-profile-claude-isolation.md asserts "Read-only roles now run against a credential-free source snapshot in a network-isolated container," and scripts/ai_engine.sh:43-44 comments "Read-profile calls use a network-isolated container and a bounded, credential-free source snapshot" — none of which is backed by runtime wiring. The deny-rule additions in READ_PROFILE_DENY (scripts/claude_engine.py:184-197) are defence-in-depth, not a substitute for the primary isolation safeguard.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
